name: Mismatch Bin vs Stock Ledger Entry
query:
select sle.item_code , sle.warehouse , tbin.actual_qty , SUM(sle.actual_qty) sle_qty
from `tabBin` tbin
left join `tabStock Ledger Entry` sle on sle.item_code = tbin.item_code and sle.warehouse = tbin.warehouse 
left join `tabItem` item on item.item_code = sle.item_code 
where sle.is_cancelled = 0 and item.item_code is not NULL 
and sle.serial_and_batch_bundle is not null
group by sle.item_code, sle.warehouse  
having tbin.actual_qty != sle_qty ;
report_name: Mismatch Bin vs Stock Ledger Entry
